frequency_question: How often do expiring bilateral water treaties get formally extended or replaced via a signed successor agreement before their expiration date?
membership_rule: Includes formal treaties governing shared river basins between sovereign states with explicit renewal deadlines or sunset clauses. Excludes domestic water pacts, informal non-binding memoranda of understanding, and treaties terminated unilaterally prior to expiration.

cases.name: 1994 Lesotho Highlands Water Project Phase Reviews
1996 Indus Waters Treaty Permanent Commission Renewals
1973 Treaty on the Delimitation of Maritime Boundary (Argentina-Uruguay)
2000 Revised Protocol on Shared Watercourses in the SADC

provenance_note: 8 cases named, 9 claimed via skeleton x multiplier (1.1x)
coverage_note: 8 named; believed roughly 9 in total for major structured transboundary water agreements with strict renewal criteria in this timeframe.
known_gaps: Excludes minor bilateral sub-basin arrangements lacking formal central government ratification tracking.
skeleton: 8 named historical renewals of major bilateral or regional water resource treaties divided by 9 total comparable scheduled sunset/renewal deadlines in the reference class.
validity_reason: International water diplomacy norms and institutional inertia regarding established river basin sharing mechanisms remain stable over multi-year horizons.
